headline: Food Plant Machine Operator
summary: Agriculture graduate and former farm technician now operating canning and packing machines at a fruit processing plant in Palawan. Four years managing cashew and fruit farms gave me a strong sense of product quality from the field; I now run the canning line machines and inspect product before packing.

certifications.name: Basic Food Safety and HACCP Awareness

skills: Quality inspection of raw fruit and finished cans

experience.title: Machine Operator
bullets: Operate filling, seaming and retort machines on the canned mango and pineapple line.
Pack cans into cartons and label them for storage.
Inspect incoming fruit and finished cans and set aside rejects.

experience.title: Farm Technician
experience.employer: Palawan Cashew and Fruit Growers Cooperative
bullets: Managed planting, fertilising and pest control on 40 hectares of cashew and mango.
Supervised harvesting and grading of fruit for buyers and processors.
Trained member farmers on proper harvest and post-harvest handling.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Agriculture, major in Horticulture
